sections.shortTitle: Federal Ministers and Ministers of State Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE (SALARIES ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE (SALARIES
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to Amend the Federal Ministers and Minister of State (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, )975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-1, 4th October, 2002)
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
4-10-2002,---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Federal Ministers and
Ministers of State (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance,
20Q2,
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 17, Act LXII of 1975

FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE (SALARIES ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
FEDERAL MINISTERS AND MINISTERS OF STATE (SALARIES
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to Amend the Federal Ministers and Minister of State (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, )975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-1, 4th October, 2002)
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
4-10-2002,---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 17,
Act LXII of 1975.--In the Federal Ministers and Ministers of State
(Salaries, .Allowances and Privileges) Act. 1975 (LXII of 1975), in section
17.--
(i) in
subsection (1), the words "in the case of a Federal Minister and two
months in the case of a Minister of State" shall be omitted, and
(ii) before
proviso to subsection (1), the following new proviso shall be inserted,
namely:--
"Provided that a Federal Minister and a Minister of
State shall earn, four days leave per month subject to a maxim of three
months."
